candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to classify or segment companies against ICPs in a connected GTM context. Not for account scoring, company research, ICP authoring, lead segmentation, or repository management.
candidates.rationale: Direct task noun and sibling exclusions.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to classify, segment, route, or bucket companies against ICPs in a connected GTM context. Not for scoring already-labeled accounts, researching or enriching companies, defining ICPs, segmenting leads, or managing the context repository.
candidates.rationale: Covers common segmentation verbs while making the labels-in scoring seam explicit.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user wants one ICP segment or no-match assigned to each supplied company using a connected GTM context. Not for point or band scoring, enrichment, account research, ICP creation, people segmentation, or context setup.
candidates.rationale: Describes the observable output and sharpens company-versus-person intent.
